name: infographic-docs
description: External tools that improve infographic-docs generation, preview, diagrams, charts, and optional shadcn mode.
toolFinderQuery: infographic docs html accessibility shadcn diagrams charts playwright mcp

externalTools.name: shadcn
externalTools.reason: Use only when the user explicitly asks for shadcn or app-style docs.

externalTools.name: Playwright MCP
externalTools.reason: Preview generated docs through localhost and capture screenshots, snapshots, and PDFs.

externalTools.name: Playwright Test
externalTools.reason: Optional scripted browser checks for generated docs.

externalTools.name: Mermaid
externalTools.reason: Render simple flowcharts and sequence diagrams inside docs.

externalTools.name: Mermaid CLI
externalTools.reason: Pre-render Mermaid diagrams to SVG or PNG assets.

externalTools.name: Vega-Lite
externalTools.reason: Render declarative chart specs to SVG or PNG assets.

externalTools.name: Vega
externalTools.reason: Runtime package needed by Vega-Lite CLI exporters.

externalTools.name: Observable Plot
externalTools.reason: Reference package for lightweight explanatory chart patterns.

externalTools.name: D3
externalTools.reason: Reference package for custom infographic patterns when simple specs are not enough.

externalTools.name: html-validate
externalTools.reason: Optional structural validation for generated standalone HTML.

externalTools.name: pa11y
externalTools.reason: Optional accessibility reports for generated docs.

externalTools.name: axe-core
externalTools.reason: Reference accessibility engine for future validation scripts.

externalTools.name: lighthouse
externalTools.reason: Optional performance and accessibility quality reports.
